caption: Exploratory validation-only reuse of top-10%, top-25%, top-50% and ordinary constrained trajectories. Four-rollout mixtures rotate component assignments over four distinct sample identities and average metrics within each protein; rotations reuse trajectories and are not independent observations. Full pools include four trajectories per component (12 or 16). Sum q is used except where labeled. The full 16-rollout F1-squared point is the highest all-contact mixture result among three prespecified aggregation rules; this display does not constitute a separate confirmation. Warm cost sums the original included-trajectory inference timings and excludes loading, staging and CPU aggregation. These mixtures add no GPU work. Top-20% and within-rollout threshold changes were not tested. Reserved-test configurations remain unchanged.
